solution.what: Grepped the cached Tomokiyo page (targets/vasto1527/prior/spanish2C_now.htm) for R9955/R9956: both deciphered at the time on separate sheets, R9955 printed in Luo 2021 p. 285; R9956 not from Isabella.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): entries added with summaries only: neither letter's cipher nor its contemporary decipherment (separate sheets, images not viewed) is transcribed, and Luo 2021 (R9955) has no link.

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): no text of R9955 or R9956 is in the repository (decipherment sheets on the DECODE images; R9955 printed by Luo 2021). Both relabelled decoded, not read; class already solved kept (in print).

Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, b20): every file on DECODE R9955 (6 images) and R9956 (8 images) fetched with the shared cookie into the session scratchpad (b20_fetch.py); no DOC_* or other attachments. R9955 P3 is doc. 196, the contemporary decipherment of the letter's three cipher passages; R9956 P4/P8 are doc. 206, the contemporary decipherment of its cipher passage. Never opened before (closed 21 Sept from Tomokiyo).

Clear text of both letters and both decipherment sheets transcribed from native-resolution strips (b20_crop.py); doubtful places zoomed. R9956's address reads 'Al muy noble señor mi sobrino Juan Vazquez, secretario de Su Mag.t', confirming Tomokiyo's guess at the recipient; signature Cobos.

Figures spot-checked against the general cipher AGS Estado leg. 1.1.1 doc. 112 printed (as images) by Luo (2021) p. 601: R9955 'las necesidades' (la-s-ne-ce-si-da-de-s), R9956 'despachandose este correo de mercaderes ... sazon'. Agree; not decoded sign by sign. R9956's sheet ends 'a x[?] de hebrero' where the letter's clear date is 'a xj de enero de 1531'; the reading follows the letter.

Readings written from the clear text and the decipherments (texts/R9955_reading.md, R9956_reading.md; English R9955_en.md, R9956_en.md; log R9955-R9956_reread_log.md); no word supplied. b17_score.py on the bodies (es): R9955 0.744 (29/39), explicit holes 1.00; R9956 0.714 (10/14), explicit holes 1.00; before: no text. Both set read, grade A.

texts.label: R9955, Charles V to Isabella, Regensburg 30 Apr 1532 (AGS Estado 496 ff. 195-196)
texts.summary: Charles V at Regensburg to the Empress Isabella, 30 April 1532 (DECODE: Isabella to Charles, 1531): he has taken a loan of 100,000 escudos from Ansaldo de Grimaldo, Genoese, to be repaid in 1533 by bills of exchange on Alonso de Baeza, secured by a juro on Castilian revenues, with a life grant in Naples; the cipher passages explain that the 100,000 ducats for his departure are not enough and press her to have the bills accepted at once. Read from the contemporary decipherment (doc. 196, on the DECODE images); also printed by Luo (2021) pp. 285-287.

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b20): clear text of doc. 195 and the contemporary decipherment of its three cipher passages (doc. 196, DECODE image P3, never transcribed before) transcribed from the images; figures spot-checked against the doc. 112 key printed by Luo (2021) p. 601 ('las necesidades'). No word supplied. Body 0.744 clean sentences (29/39), explicit holes 1.00; the unclean sentences are period spellings and names.

texts.label: R9956, Francisco de los Cobos to his nephew Juan Vázquez, Brussels 11 Jan 1531 (AGS Estado 496 ff. 205-206)
texts.summary: Francisco de los Cobos (signed 'Covos comendador mayor') to his nephew Juan Vázquez [de Molina], secretary, Brussels, 11 January 1531 (DECODE: Isabella to Charles V). Clear: Benavides's departure, the courier of the archdeacon of Segovia about the Toledo regimiento. Cipher: news for the Empress: the Emperor is well and busy with the Low Countries; Monsieur de Praet gone to France; no answer yet to the Protonotary Gambara on the council, pending the King of the Romans' opinion; Italy quiet, the Siena exiles restored and the Spanish infantry kept nearby; the Pope as before; contradictory reports of the Turk coming by Hungary and Italy. Read from the contemporary decipherment (doc. 206, on the DECODE images).

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b20): clear text of f. 205 and the contemporary decipherment of the cipher passage (doc. 206 recto and verso, DECODE images P4/P8, never transcribed before) transcribed from the images; figures spot-checked against the doc. 112 key (Luo 2021 p. 601): 'despachandose este correo de mercaderes ... sazon'. No word supplied; four doubtful words [?] and the line 'De hebrero [...]'. Body 0.714 clean sentences (10/14), explicit holes 1.00.
